description: This file defines enums, structs, and type aliases related to motion commands and activity data within the OpenClawKit project. It includes data models for motion activities, pedometer data, and parameters associated with them.

methods.name: OpenClawMotionActivityEntry.init
methods.description: Initializer for OpenClawMotionActivityEntry struct, sets all activity-related properties with provided values.

methods.name: OpenClawMotionActivityPayload.init
methods.description: Initializer for OpenClawMotionActivityPayload struct, initializes with a list of activity entries.

methods.name: OpenClawPedometerParams.init
methods.description: Initializer for OpenClawPedometerParams struct, sets optional start and end ISO date strings.

methods.name: OpenClawPedometerPayload.init
methods.description: Initializer for OpenClawPedometerPayload struct, sets start/end ISO dates and optional pedometer data.
